categories.name: 前沿论文
categories.commentary: 这批论文集中在Agent自主实验、生成模型的数据与评估方法、以及LLM安全与常识推理三条线上。

articles.title: Autonomous Quantum Measurement with Agentic AI
articles.zh: 基于Agentic AI的自主量子测量
articles.summary: 如果你关心Agent怎么走出对话框进实验室，这篇讲的是让Agent自己设计并跑完量子测量流程
articles.author: Eunbi Rha, Abhijatmedhi Chotrattanapituk 等
articles.body: Quantum materials exhibit diverse electronic and functional phenomena, but their characterization requires extensive experimental expertise, iterative decision-making and accumulated laboratory knowledge that is difficult to document and transfer. Here we introduce Quantum Agent (QUANTA), an agentic artificial intelligence (AI) framework for autonomous quantum-materials characterization. Using a widely adopted Physical Property Measurement System (PPMS) as an experimental platform, QUANTA combines retrieval augmentation using scientific literature, experimental protocols and prior measurements with specialized agents for experimental planning, troubleshooting, and data interpretation. A separate deterministic control layer validates instrument actions. Guided by incoming data, QUANTA evaluates measurement quality, revises experimental plans and selects subsequent measurements. We demonstrate these capabilities through transport measurements of the topological Weyl semimetal TaP, as well as investigations of nonlinear responses in magnetic material Co2MnGa. These results establish QUANTA as a generalizable framework for evidence-driven, safeguarded and closed-loop quantum-materials characterization.
articles.bodyZh: 量子材料（quantum materials）能展现出各种各样的电子现象和功能特性，但要想把它们表征（characterization）清楚，得靠大量实验经验、一步步反复做决策，还得靠实验室里长期积累的知识，而这些知识往往很难记录、也很难传给别人。为此，我们提出了 Quantum Agent（QUANTA），这是一个用于自主量子材料表征的智能体式人工智能（agentic AI）框架。它把一种广泛使用的物性测量系统（Physical Property Measurement System, PPMS）当作实验平台，一方面用科学文献、实验流程和以往测量数据来做检索增强（retrieval augmentation），另一方面配上专门负责实验规划、故障排查和数据解读的智能体。另外还有一套独立的确定性控制层（deterministic control layer），专门校验仪器操作。QUANTA 会根据新进来的数据判断测量质量、修改实验方案，并决定接下来测什么。我们用拓扑外尔半金属（topological Weyl semimetal）TaP 的输运测量（transport measurements），以及对磁性材料 Co2MnGa 中非线性响应（nonlinear responses）的研究，展示了这些能力。这些结果表明，QUANTA 可以成为一个通用框架，用来做由证据驱动、有安全保障、闭环的量子材料表征。

articles.title: What to randomize matters: a controlled study of volume, axis and representation in low-data molecular generation
articles.zh: 该随机什么才关键：低数据分子生成中随机量、随机轴与表示方式的控制变量研究
articles.summary: 如果你在做小样本分子生成，这篇提醒你数据增强里"往哪个方向随机"比"随机多少"更决定成败
articles.author: Neerav Kaushal, Alisa Teige 等
articles.body: Chemical language models can struggle to generate new molecules when trained on small datasets, where a model may reproduce training examples rather than learn a useful generative distribution. Randomized SMILES augmentation varies atom traversal, whereas Sequential Attachment-based Fragment Embedding (SAFE) also allows the order of fragment blocks to vary. How these distinct sources of representational variation affect low-data molecular generation has not been clearly studied. Here, using 1,000 seed molecules to train an autoregressive sequence model, we compare canonical SAFE with randomized SAFE at increasing corpus sizes, isolate atom-order and fragment-order axes of SAFE randomization, and compare fully randomized SAFE with randomized SMILES at molecule-by-molecule matched training corpora. Three findings emerge. First, randomization of SAFE alone raises the genuine yield of novel molecules more than 450-fold, turning a model that merely reproduces its training set into a practical molecular generator. Second, the two axes of randomization act jointly rather than additively: atom order alone reaches a tenth, and fragment order alone a seventh, of the genuine yield obtained when both vary, which is four times their combined contribution. Third, at matched corpus size and compute, randomized SAFE delivers 2.8 times the genuine yield of randomized SMILES. Welch tests with Games-Howell post-hoc comparisons resolve every difference on the primary outcomes. In the low-data regime, thus, what one randomizes rather than only how much determines whether augmentation produces new molecules or merely new spellings of the training set.
articles.bodyZh: 化学语言模型（chemical language models）在小数据集上训练时，往往很难生成真正的新分子，模型更容易把训练样本原样“背”出来，而不是学到一个有用的生成分布（generative distribution）。随机化SMILES增强（Randomized SMILES augmentation）会改变原子遍历顺序，而基于顺序连接的片段嵌入（Sequential Attachment-based Fragment Embedding，SAFE）还能让片段块的顺序也发生变化。这两种表示层面的随机性来源，对低数据量下的分子生成到底有什么影响，此前还没有被清楚研究过。这里，我们用1000个种子分子训练一个自回归序列模型（autoregressive sequence model），在不断增加语料规模的情况下比较规范SAFE和随机化SAFE，把SAFE随机化拆成原子顺序和片段顺序两个维度分别看，并在逐分子匹配的训练语料上比较完全随机化SAFE和随机化SMILES。结果有三个发现。第一，只对SAFE做随机化，就能把真正生成新分子的产出提高450倍以上，让一个原本只会复现训练集的模型变成真正可用的分子生成器。第二，这两个随机化维度是共同起作用的，不是简单相加：只随机原子顺序，只能达到两者都随机时真正新分子产出的十分之一；只随机片段顺序，只能达到七分之一；而两者一起变化的产出，是它们各自贡献相加后的四倍。第三，在语料规模和计算量都匹配的情况下，随机化SAFE的真正新分子产出是随机化SMILES的2.8倍。Welch检验（Welch tests）配合Games-Howell事后比较（Games-Howell post-hoc comparisons），把主要结果上的每一个差异都解释清楚了。所以在低数据场景下，关键不只是“增强多少”，而是“随机化什么”，这决定了增强到底是在产生新分子，还是只是在给训练集换新写法。

articles.title: Discovering Jailbreaks via Curriculum of Models
articles.zh: 用模型课程发现越狱攻击
articles.summary: 如果你在评估自家模型的安全防线，这套拿由弱到强的一串模型当"课程"来挖漏洞的办法，比单模型反复试探更容易找到真口子
articles.author: Michał Burzyński, Noah T. Rossi 等
articles.body: Automated jailbreak discovery aims to find prompts that elicit prohibited behaviors from safety-trained language models, helping developers identify vulnerabilities before deployment. One class of approaches uses reinforcement learning to train an investigator model to generate prompts that elicit a specified behavior from a target model. However, training directly against a safety-trained target is difficult because nearly all prompts are refused, leaving the investigator with a sparse reward signal. Prior work addresses this with the propensity bound (PRBO), a proxy reward estimated by sampling responses from a more compliant target, and then adjusting for how likely those responses would have been under the original target. We introduce Curriculum of Models (CoM), an alternative method that trains the investigator against a sequence of modified versions of the target, progressing gradually from a version that readily exhibits the specified behavior to the original target. For jailbreak discovery, training begins against a target version that rarely refuses harmful requests, and advances to the next, harder version once the investigator reliably elicits the behavior from the current one. We evaluate CoM on elicitation tasks involving CBRN materials, explosives, and illicit drugs, using two open-weight targets, gemma-4-31b-it and gpt-oss-120b. We compare against PRBO and direct training on the original target without a curriculum. When the investigator is trained to elicit a single behavior, CoM finds successful jailbreaks more reliably than either baseline. When trained on multiple behaviors simultaneously, the CoM-trained investigator can elicit held-out behaviors, though PRBO-trained investigators achieve higher success rates. Our results suggest that a simple curriculum over target models offers a promising approach for addressing sparse rewards in rare-behavior elicitation.
articles.bodyZh: 自动化越狱发现（automated jailbreak discovery）想做的，是找出一些提示词（prompts），让经过安全训练的语言模型表现出被禁止的行为，帮开发者在模型上线前发现漏洞。有一类方法用强化学习（reinforcement learning）训练一个调查员模型（investigator model），让它生成提示词，去诱导目标模型（target model）表现出某种指定行为。可要是直接拿经过安全训练的目标模型来训，就很难，因为几乎所有提示词都会被拒绝，调查员能拿到的奖励信号就特别稀疏（sparse reward signal）。之前的工作用倾向边界（propensity bound，PRBO）来对付这个问题：先从更听话的目标模型里采样回答，估出一个替代奖励（proxy reward），再根据这些回答在原始目标模型下有多可能出现来做调整。我们提出模型课程（Curriculum of Models，CoM），这是另一种方法：让调查员依次对着目标模型的一连串修改版本训练，从很容易表现出指定行为的版本开始，逐步过渡到原始目标模型。在越狱发现任务里，训练一开始对着一个很少拒绝有害请求的目标版本，等调查员能稳定地从当前版本诱导出这个行为后，再进入下一个更难的版本。我们在涉及 CBRN 材料（CBRN materials）、爆炸物和非法药物的诱导任务上评估 CoM，用了两个开放权重（open-weight）的目标模型：gemma-4-31b-it 和 gpt-oss-120b。我们拿它和 PRBO，以及不带课程、直接在原始目标模型上训练的方法做对比。当调查员只训练去诱导一种行为时，CoM 找到成功越狱提示词比两个基线方法都更稳。当同时训练多种行为时，用 CoM 训练出来的调查员也能诱导出留出的行为（held-out behaviors），不过用 PRBO 训练的调查员成功率更高。我们的结果表明，对目标模型做一个简单的课程安排，是解决稀有行为诱导（rare-behavior elicitation）中奖励稀疏问题的一条挺有希望的路子。

articles.title: Evaluating Visual Realism of AI-Generated Videos with Eye Tracking
articles.zh: 用眼动追踪评估AI生成视频的视觉真实感
articles.summary: 如果你想知道AI视频到底"哪里假"，眼动数据比人主观打分更早暴露破绽
articles.author: Danqing Shi, Lan Jiang 等
articles.body: Human evaluation of AI-generated videos has so far relied on explicit human feedback, such as judgments or ratings. While these signals capture the conclusions viewers reach, they fail to offer insights into the perception that leads to them. This paper investigates eye tracking as a complementary human evaluation signal for AI-generated videos. We conducted two Visual Turing Test (VTT) experiments with a total of 90 participants on videos generated by latest generative models, in which participants watched each video twice and then gave their feedback. Across the experiments, we collected 4,286 valid eye-tracking trials on 438 videos. Our analysis indicates that gaze patterns offer informative evaluation signals that align with explicit human feedback. Building on the findings, we propose the first computational method GazeEval to predict the perceived visual realism of AI-generated videos from eye-tracking data. It achieves 71.3% accuracy in prediction, providing evidence that eye tracking data carries informative signals about how people evaluate a video. We release the study data to support further research on eye tracking for evaluating AI-generated video.
articles.bodyZh:
到目前为止，对AI生成视频做人类评估，一直靠的是明确的真人反馈，比如让人做判断或者打分。这些信号能反映观众最后得出的结论，但看不出他们是怎么感知、怎么一步步形成这个结论的。

这篇论文研究的是，把眼动追踪（eye tracking）当成一种补充的人类评估信号，用来评估AI生成视频。我们做了两个视觉图灵测试（Visual Turing Test, VTT）实验，总共90名参与者，看的视频由最新生成模型（generative models）生成；每个视频他们看两遍，然后给出反馈。

两个实验加起来，我们在438个视频上收集到了4286次有效眼动追踪试次。

分析发现，注视模式（gaze patterns）能提供有信息量的评估信号，而且和显式人类反馈（explicit human feedback）是一致的。

基于这些发现，我们提出了首个计算方法GazeEval，用眼动数据来预测AI生成视频在观众眼里的感知视觉真实感（perceived visual realism）。

它的预测准确率达到71.3%，这说明眼动数据里确实带着有用信号，能反映人们是怎么评价一个视频的。

我们会公开研究数据，支持后续研究用眼动追踪来评估AI生成视频。

articles.title: CopyLoop: Fast Looped Transformer Decoding via Context Copying and Shallow Screening
articles.zh: CopyLoop：通过上下文复制与浅层筛选加速循环Transformer解码
articles.summary: 如果你被循环深度带来的解码延迟卡住，这套"该抄上下文就抄、浅层先筛一遍"的思路能砍掉大量重复计算
articles.author: Wenyu Du, Stephen Chung
articles.body: Looped Transformers increase computational capacity through the repeated application of shared blocks, but their recurrent depth makes conventional full-depth decoding expensive. While existing speculative pipelines accelerate generation by processing consecutive token positions at varying depths, they are typically limited by sequential decoding overheads. We introduce CopyLoop, a training-free decoding algorithm that combines low-cost context-copy proposals with shallow screening and continuous recurrent scheduling. Rather than step-by-step generation, CopyLoop proposes multi-token suffixes from repeated context. It then evaluates them early at a shallow recurrent depth to efficiently filter out incorrect branches, processing newer blocks concurrently while earlier blocks are still progressing toward full-depth verification. We evaluate CopyLoop across six model checkpoints from the Ouro, Raven, and Huginn families, covering code generation and multi-step mathematical reasoning. CopyLoop achieves decoding speedups of 2.98x--10.70x over full-depth autoregressive decoding on Base models and 2.74x--3.52x on Thinking models, consistently outperforming or closely matching all competing baselines across evaluation tasks. Furthermore, ablation studies confirm a strong synergy between shallow screening and continuous scheduling, while our analyses show that CopyLoop requires only lightweight model calibration and yields greater speedups on longer generations with reusable contexts.
articles.bodyZh: 循环式 Transformer（Looped Transformers）靠反复套用共享模块（shared blocks）来提升算力，但这种循环深度（recurrent depth）让传统的全深度解码变得很费成本。现有的推测式流水线（speculative pipelines）虽然能通过在不同深度处理连续词元（token）位置来加速生成，但通常受限于顺序解码的开销。我们提出 CopyLoop，一种免训练（training-free）的解码算法，把低成本的上下文复制（context-copy）候选、浅层筛选（shallow screening）和连续循环调度（continuous recurrent scheduling）结合起来。它不是一步一步生成，而是从重复出现的上下文里提出多词元后缀（multi-token suffixes），然后提早在浅层循环深度（shallow recurrent depth）评估这些候选，快速过滤掉错误分支；同时，较早的块还在往全深度验证（full-depth verification）推进时，就能并行处理更新的块。我们在 Ouro、Raven 和 Huginn 三个系列的六个模型检查点（checkpoints）上评估 CopyLoop，覆盖代码生成和多步数学推理。在基础模型（Base models）上，CopyLoop 相比全深度自回归解码取得 2.98 倍到 10.70 倍的解码加速；在思考模型（Thinking models）上是 2.74 倍到 3.52 倍，并且在各项评估任务上始终优于或接近所有竞争基线（baselines）。此外，消融研究（ablation studies）证实浅层筛选和连续调度之间有很强的协同效应；我们的分析还表明，CopyLoop 只需要轻量级的模型校准（calibration），而且在上下文可复用、生成长度更长时加速更明显。

articles.title: Gold vs.~Translation: Are We Measuring Language, Knowledge, or Locality in Translated Benchmarks?
articles.zh: 人工标注还是机器翻译：翻译版基准到底在测语言能力、知识还是本地化？
articles.summary: 如果你用翻译版benchmark评多语言能力，这篇会告诉你分数里混进了翻译噪声，排名结论别照单全收
articles.author: Klaudia-Doris Thellmann, Bernhard Stadler 等
articles.body: Translated versions of English-origin benchmarks such as MMLU are widely used to evaluate large language models in non-English languages, yet it remains unclear whether they measure the same constructs as natively created benchmarks. We frame this as a proxy validity question and compare DeepL-translated MMLU proxies against six native benchmarks in seven pairings across five Nordic and Baltic languages, evaluating 29 models on each pairing. Beyond ranking agreement, we test incremental proxy validity: does the translated score add predictive value for native performance after controlling for model size and language proficiency? Proxy validity varies substantially across benchmark pairings. Applying the same robustness criteria to all seven pairings, we find four robust effects, two marginal effects, and one null result. The strongest evidence occurs for curriculum-overlap benchmarks such as Skolprov ($ΔR^2$=.128, 95% CI [.038,.253]), whereas translated MMLU provides no significant incremental value for Sweden-specific factual knowledge in SwedishFacts (p=.242). Because SwedishFacts is also the only open-ended benchmark, we cannot fully separate the effects of local content and response format. Overall, the results indicate a clear pattern: translated benchmarks provide a better proxy when their source content overlaps with the native evaluation target, while locally anchored knowledge is less reliably captured.
articles.bodyZh: 像MMLU这类源自英文的基准测试，它们的翻译版本被广泛用于评估非英语语言的大语言模型，但这些翻译版是否和原生创建的基准测量的是同样的东西，目前还不清楚。我们把这个当作一个代理效度（proxy validity）问题来看，比较了DeepL翻译的MMLU代理版本和六个原生基准，在五种北欧和波罗的海语言中做了七组配对，每组配对评估了29个模型。除了看排名一致性，我们还测试了增量代理效度：在控制了模型规模和语言熟练度之后，翻译版的分数对原生表现还有没有额外的预测价值？代理效度在不同基准配对之间差异很大。把同样的稳健性标准应用到所有七组配对上，我们发现四个稳健效应、两个边缘效应、一个零结果。最强的证据出现在课程重叠的基准上，比如Skolprov（ΔR²=.128，95% CI [.038,.253]），而翻译版MMLU对瑞典语特定事实知识（SwedishFacts）没有显著的增量价值（p=.242）。因为SwedishFacts也是唯一一个开放式基准，我们没法完全区分本地内容和回答格式各自的影响。总的来说，结果指向一个清晰的模式：当翻译版基准的源内容和原生评估目标有重叠时，它们能提供更好的代理；而本地化的知识则没那么可靠地被捕捉到。

articles.title: Leaving, Staying, or Living There? Duration Commonsense Reasoning with Human-LLM Co-annotations
articles.zh: 离开、停留还是长住？基于人机协同标注的时长常识推理
articles.summary: 如果你在做常识推理数据，"待多久"这类时长常识是LLM的明显短板，而人机协同标注能把这个洞补上
articles.author: Chenyang Yu, Zhaomin Xiao 等
articles.body: Gardening in the backyard implies living there, while checking into an Airbnb more likely means staying for a few days. Such duration judgments are important for understanding human mobility, travel behavior, and social context. However, duration is rarely stated explicitly in social media posts and must instead be inferred from noisy textual, visual, and contextual cues. In this paper, we investigate whether vision-language models possess such duration commonsense. We create a new corpus of geotagged tweets co-annotated by humans and LLMs to serve as a testbed for this task. We find that state-of-the-art models struggle with duration inference, even when guided by multi-turn Chain-of-Thought prompting. Error analyses further reveal that models often fail to integrate critical contextual information, or they overly rely on prominent visual details while overlooking subtle hashtags and semantic nuances. These findings underscore the significant challenges remaining in context-aware multimodal understanding.
articles.bodyZh: 在后院种花种菜，说明人大概率是住在那儿的；而住进Airbnb民宿，更可能只是待上几天。这类对“待多久”的判断，对理解人类移动性（human mobility）、出行行为（travel behavior）和社会背景（social context）很重要。可问题是，社交媒体帖子很少明说时长，只能从嘈杂的文字、画面和上下文线索里去猜。这篇论文想看看：视觉语言模型（vision-language models）有没有这种“时长常识（duration commonsense）”。我们建了一个新语料库（corpus），里面的地理标记推文（geotagged tweets）由人类和大语言模型（LLMs）共同标注，用来当作这项任务的测试平台（testbed）。结果发现，哪怕用多轮思维链提示（multi-turn Chain-of-Thought prompting）来引导，最先进模型（state-of-the-art models）还是搞不定时长推断。错误分析还显示，模型常常整合不好关键上下文信息，或者太盯着显眼的画面细节，反而忽略不起眼的话题标签（hashtags）和语义上的细微差别。这些发现说明，上下文感知的多模态理解（context-aware multimodal understanding）仍然面临不小的挑战。

articles.title: AtomTree: A Hierarchical Framework for State-Aware Embodied Instruction Following with LLMs
articles.zh: AtomTree：面向LLM状态感知具身指令跟随的分层框架
articles.summary: 如果你在做具身指令跟随，这套把长指令拆成分层原子动作并持续跟踪执行状态的框架，能减少中途跑偏
articles.author: Haotian Zhai, Tianming Sha 等
articles.body: Embodied instruction following in interactive environments requires agents to interpret natural language commands and complete long-horizon tasks. Existing planners either rely on large labeled trajectories, or use few-shot and zero-shot LLM prompting that produces a whole plan in a single serial reasoning process. These approaches depend on linguistic common sense, commit to a plan from the initial instruction, and only update after failures, which weakens robustness and state awareness. We present AtomTree, a hierarchical framework for state-aware task planning with LLMs. AtomTree incrementally builds a tree of subgoals and actions, where the LLM decides at each step, from the current symbolic state, whether to further decompose or to output a grounded low-level action. A lightweight memory module summarizes past outcomes for reuse in later decisions. When a low-level action stalls, AtomTree triggers hierarchical backtracking replanning to return to the parent node and regenerate the subtree plan from the latest state, preventing continued drift along an incorrect trajectory. In zero-shot evaluation on the ALFRED benchmark, AtomTree outperforms prior LLM-based planners. Project page: https://zhaihaotian.github.io/atomtree-website/.
articles.bodyZh: 在交互环境里做具身指令跟随（Embodied instruction following），智能体（agents）得听懂自然语言命令，还得把长程任务（long-horizon tasks）一步步做完。现有的规划器，要么靠大量带标注的轨迹（labeled trajectories）来训练，要么用少样本（few-shot）和零样本（zero-shot）的大语言模型（LLM）提示，一次性串行推理（serial reasoning process）出一整套计划。这些方法主要依赖语言常识（linguistic common sense），一上来就按最初指令定死计划，只有失败了才更新，结果就是鲁棒性和状态感知（state awareness）都偏弱。我们提出了 AtomTree，一个用 LLM 做状态感知任务规划（state-aware task planning）的分层框架（hierarchical framework）。AtomTree 会增量式地构建一棵由子目标（subgoals）和动作（actions）组成的树，每一步都由 LLM 根据当前的符号状态（symbolic state）来决定：是继续往下拆解，还是直接输出一个落到实处的底层动作（grounded low-level action）。一个轻量记忆模块（lightweight memory module）会总结过去的结果，供后面的决策复用。当某个底层动作卡住时，AtomTree 会触发分层回溯重规划（hierarchical backtracking replanning），回到父节点（parent node），再根据最新状态重新生成子树计划（subtree plan），避免沿着错误轨迹继续跑偏。在 ALFRED 基准测试（ALFRED benchmark）的零样本评估（zero-shot evaluation）中，AtomTree 的表现超过了此前基于 LLM 的规划器（LLM-based planners）。项目主页：https://zhaihaotian.github.io/atomtree-website/。
